note: held-unevenly: the catalog delivers value 2010..2025; the steward holds value for 2018..2019 and the register (value and other) for 2017..2021. In holdings scope a dated warning is clipped to the held periods (#1900): value's 'since 2010' (2010..9999-12-31) reads 2018-01-01..2019-12-31, value's 2021 warning lies wholly outside them and is dropped, and the register-wide 2015..2017 warning is clipped to the register's held span, 2017-01-01..2017-12-31. Reference scope returns all three with their stored windows. Fails if holdings keeps a warning's reference window (the pre-#1900 reader returned 2010-01-01 and kept the 2021 warning), drops a warning that overlaps the held periods, or clips in reference scope.
